info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Careers Applications Referrals-v5-spec
info.description: The Career Applications Referral Listing API provides access to a comprehensive list of career applications generated through referrals. Businesses can utilize this API to track and analyze referral-driven applications, enhancing recruitment strategies and improving candidate sourcing. The API serves hiring managers and HR personnel who are interested in monitoring the effectiveness of referral programs. By leveraging this resource, organizations can efficiently manage and optimize their hiring processes based on referral data.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of referral applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all referral applications submitted to the system. It supports pagination and filtering to help in managing large datasets effectively.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the referral applications.
